output.reason: No unit states an actual price. The disclaimer units (U-RX-EDU-001-09, U-RX-EDU-002-07, U-WEB-FAQ-01) only explain how an estimate is built and are meant to go alongside a quoted price. U-WEB-FAQ-05 and U-WEB-FAQ-06 only say who to call. A real price needs the member's plan record and the specific drug. Separately, 20 units were supplied instead of the stated maximum of three, and two disclaimer units (U-RX-EDU-001-09 and U-RX-EDU-002-07) are near-duplicates with slightly different wording, so the unit set should be checked.
